Current vacancies

Search all our current vacancies and find your next job at the University of Stirling.

If the right vacancy is not yet available for you why not create an email alert for jobs. You can also find out more about the wide range of benefits you'll enjoy working at Stirling.

Job alerts

To create job alert simply enter your desired criteria into the search form at the top of the page then click the 'Set Job Alert' button above.

Fill in the form that pops out with your email address and desired contact frequency then click the 'Set Job Alert' button on the form.

You will have the choice to opt out of the alert in the email confirmation.
